description: This file defines the EmailService interface, which declares methods for sending HTML emails, retrieving email configurations, and saving email configurations within the context of a MerchantStore.

classes.name: EmailService
classes.description: Interface for email-related operations such as sending emails and managing email configurations.

methods.name: sendHtmlEmail
methods.description: Sends an HTML email to the specified merchant store, may throw ServiceException or generic Exception.

methods.name: getEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves the email configuration for the specified merchant store, may throw ServiceException.

methods.name: saveEmailConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the provided email configuration for the specified merchant store, may throw ServiceException.
